name: Feiniu fnOS NAS Connector
author: OmniDesk
description: User-configured fnOS NAS connector (L1 local mount, L2 subtitle clip search & reading sync, L3 Radarr/Sonarr matching) with atomic protected subtitle write-back.

config_schema.label: NAS 本地挂载根目录 (L1)
config_schema.description: User-configured local mount directory for fnOS NAS (leave empty until configured; no hardcoded paths)

config_schema.label: 影视扫描子目录
config_schema.description: Comma-separated relative directories under mount_root for movies, series, and subtitles

config_schema.label: 音乐扫描子目录
config_schema.description: Comma-separated relative directories under mount_root for audio tracks and LRC lyrics

config_schema.label: 书籍扫描子目录
config_schema.description: Comma-separated relative directories under mount_root for eBooks and reading sync metadata

config_schema.label: 受管字幕写入子目录（可选）
config_schema.description: Optional comma-separated relative directories under mount_root allowed for write_subtitle (empty = any non-hidden dir under mount_root)

config_schema.label: 目标字幕语言
config_schema.description: Target language tag for bilingual subtitle preference and matching

config_schema.label: 拒绝覆盖人工精校字幕
config_schema.description: When enabled, write_subtitle refuses to overwrite existing manual/human-curated subtitles

config_schema.label: 伴随字幕检索服务 URL (L2)
config_schema.description: Optional LAN subtitle search HTTP service base URL (trust_env=False, follow_redirects=False)

config_schema.label: 字幕检索 Bearer Token
config_schema.description: Stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault for media_service_url Authorization

config_schema.label: 阅读与生词同步 URL (L2)
config_schema.description: Optional LAN companion progress/vocab sync HTTP base URL (trust_env=False, follow_redirects=False)

config_schema.label: 伴随同步 Bearer Token
config_schema.description: Stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault for companion_sync_url Authorization

config_schema.label: Radarr 服务 URL (L3)
config_schema.description: Optional Radarr v3 LAN base URL for movie local matching

config_schema.label: Radarr API Key
config_schema.description: Stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault for Radarr X-Api-Key header

config_schema.label: Sonarr 服务 URL (L3)
config_schema.description: Optional Sonarr v3 LAN base URL for series local matching

config_schema.label: Sonarr API Key
config_schema.description: Stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault for Sonarr X-Api-Key header

config_schema.label: Arr 容器路径映射前缀
config_schema.description: Optional remote path prefix returned by Radarr/Sonarr to rewrite onto local mount_root

config_schema.label: 局域网请求超时 (秒)
config_schema.description: Timeout in seconds for optional L2/L3 LAN HTTP calls
